this module's own rule, in the D-28 list above and older than #421:
the exemption — and by the same asymmetry a clearance — is for a PR
nobody objected to, never over an objection somebody raised. That
carve-out is NOT spelled out by CLAUDE.md § The review half of `merge-policy` is a second session, not a bot,
which is why it is cited here as ours.
An objection this reader cannot attribute is not a pass, so the one
direction in which an unattributable marker still decides the set is
the fail-closed one
